notes.title: VR ON STANDBY
notes.notes:
The end of the year is usually a time for summaries and making big, exciting plans. 
We got a taste for it too!

It’s been a good year for us, for many reasons. 

Did you know that our team has already increased three times since 2019? We’re constantly growing, hiring new people and developing. We look forward to more great people joining us in the coming year. Let’s keep fingers crossed for that! 

That’s not all!  

In 2021/2022 Sony and Facebook are investing heavily in the future of VR. The new PSVR 2 and Meta Cambria will be available soon, making virtual reality an incredibly hot topic. This is increasing the demand for projects using this technology. We’re excited about this – the value of the VR market is growing so we can make bold, far-reaching plans.
[h2]
OUR PLANS FOR 2022?
[/h2]

[h3]New VR game is coming! [/h3]
Our work on the new game has actually started since the release of Stargaze. All this in total secrecy! New project is well under way, so we’ll tell you more really soon.  We can’t wait to present you a fresh take on the action-adventure genre in VR!

[h3]Stargaze – release on PS VR and Oculus Quest[/h3]
Here’s another piece of good news! PS VR and Oculus Quest owners will be able to explore our extraordinary planets on Stargaze in 2022. We will reveal the release date soon!

[h3]Constant development and growth[/h3]
 Did you know that game developers for VR platforms represent only 5% of the entire game industry in Poland? Fortunately, the popularity of VR is still growing. We are going to take advantage of that. 🙂

In short – keep your fingers crossed!

[h2]WE HAVE CHRISTMAS WISHES TOO![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38029436/6b5bfda26aa2546e3fbf1b2175b272a369004c0c.png[/img]

We wish you many fantastic games that will keep you up at night, happiness in everything you try and making your dreams come true – even the most bold ones!

[h3]LET’S PLAY WITH FIRE – FORTUNE FAVOURS THE BRAVE![/h3]

notes.title: THE COSMIC HORROR OF STARGAZE
notes.notes:
[h2]INTRO TO STARGAZE GALAXY[/h2]

Every planet you visit in Stargaze is telling its own story that fits within Stargaze’s “Little Prince” inspired galactic setting. On Ignis-6 a once fiery fox is looking for new sources of energy. On Gelat-0 three lively shrimps are getting together for an unusual ice brawl. And Florian-5 – a planet of once lush vegetation – has caught a deep rooted sickness and needs intensive treatment. The planets oscillate between zany adventures and mysterious cosmic enigmas. Of the second type Planet Specul-8 (The Crystal Planet) is possibly the most unusual one. One that required a different approach during development.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ghGdN5s.png[/img]

[h2]DESIGNING AND WEAVING THE COSMIC HORROR INTO STARGAZE[/h2]

Specul-8’s design was so unique due to spicing up our philosophical fairytale with a fair share of horror influences. The main idea was to have a dark and alien planet that encased a beast inside, which is only briefly glimpsed at until solving all the puzzles.

Right away this idea gelled with a planet made of crystal with transparent as well reflecting surfaces that distort the image the same way that halls of mirrors at amusement parks do. Add to this some layers of smudge covering the planet and some tricks of light – and now you have a set of challenges before you get to see what you can’t unsee…

[img]https://i.imgur.com/D2h2xGF.jpeg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qJVeTtx.jpg[/img]
 
[h2]PROGRESSION STRUCTURE[/h2]
 
Warning! Some lite spoilers will ensue.

[h3]PLAYER’S MAIN GOAL:[/h3]
Find out what creature dwells within and make sure it doesn’t stay… lonely.
 
[h3]
PUZZLES’ GENERAL STEPS:[/h3]

1. Clean up parts of the planet from magnetic metal chunks.
2. Introduce a source of light inside the crystal.
3. Spread the light all over the interior of the planet.
4. Combine several crystal lenses to achieve a clear, sharp vision of what hides in the planet.
5. ??? – I won’t spoil what happens at the end 🙂

[h2]NARRATION[/h2]

We asked Justin Franklin the VO artist behind the game’s mysterious narrator, to slightly change his tone for this planet. His lines also became more arabesque and had those little moments of Lovecraftian ill-gotten-wisdom and warnings to eager scientists after it’s too late to go back. All of these written delightfully by our writer Alex van der Wijst.

[h2]FUN IDEAS THAT KEPT ON GIVING[/h2]
 
The little Firefly character was important for the light spreading puzzle which was focused on reflecting light beams. Inspired by Jack-Jack from the Incredibles, we came up with the idea to have the firefly sneeze with lightbeam shots. We equipped the firefly with a long snout and gave it some cool sounds between organic allergic reaction and laser hits.

The Creature hiding within the planets was named after Played with Fire CEO’s cat Julian. This enhanced the beast’s beastliness and personality to an unforeseen degree.

***

Wish you a sweetly spooky Halloween!

And on this special day don’t forget about the Ol’ Great Cosmos looming above out there, always ready to crush you with its vast mysteries and paradoxical optics.


Igor Hardy
Lead Designer, Played with Fire

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2oezYBQ.png[/img]

notes.title: Stargaze is OUT in Steam SPACE
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that we've traveled to the far end of the known cosmos and back. Stargaze is released today! :D

Some of you have already played the PAX demo version, but this is the whole package. Besides all the new planets (of 7 planets total!), new music, and other new content, the full version adds new layers to the experience, including completing your journal using a professional astronomer's quill :)

We really hope you we'll enjoy the experience we've worked hard to deliver! Please share your thoughts about the game as reviews and/or in the Steam Forums. 

The melancholic, yet fabulous cosmos with excellent soundtrack by Thomas Regin awaits your keen eye and open mind!

notes.title: Stargaze at Steam Autumn's Game Festival!
notes.notes:
Hey folks!
We know it's Spooktober but isn't it nice to wash your eyes with something soothing after all that horror and gore?
Of course it is! 

Thanks to Steam's awesome initiative of the Autumn Game Festival we're back with a free demo of Stargaze for everyone to play. 
The event started today and will be around for a whole week.

[b]Note that it is a limited time demo, so when the Festival ends you will no longer be able to play it.[/b]

For everyone, who has tried out our recent PAX EGX demo - there is no new content available, so you may skip this build. We're hard at work polishing and expanding the game based on your feedback and our production roadmap.

[b]So what can you expect out of the demo?[/b]
The introduction to this cosmic-fable adventure game including a tutorial and one full world ready to explore. There will be some light puzzles, there will be some giggles and there will be some physical work with operating the Telescope through which you see the planets and influence life on them.

[b]So who is responsible for the game?[/b]
Us (duh!). Ok, dad jokes aside, we're called Played With Fire and we're based in Poland. This is our first exclusive VR game but we've gathered a lot of experience working on various indie PC and console titles in Poland. 
We were finally drawn into VR thanks to a side gig we did in 2019, however this passion has been building up since the first commercial headset hit the market in this century. 
Our ambition is to produce visceral and sensual VR experiences in a book illustration style. Our games are supposed to help you bring back your imagination and fascination of the world, just as it was when you were a kid. 

If you want to learn more about us and Stargaze, let us know in the comments. We may organize an AMA, if there would be a demand for it :)

All the best
Played With Fire

notes.title: Thank you for playing PAXxEGX Stargaze demo!
notes.notes:
PAX EGX has came to a close. 
We would like to thank everyone who has participated virtually in the event and tried out our exclusive and time-limited demo of Stargaze. Your feedback is as always greatly appreciated and helps us refine our vision for the game. Big kudos to all of you, who took the time and reached out to us with their comments, critique and words of encouragement.

[b]Thank you![/b]

For those who have missed our long presentation on Stargaze you can see it here:
[previewyoutube=gGmyMnFI0cQ;full][/previewyoutube]
It contains our announcement trailer, followed by a long gameplay presentation and even an interview with the composer of Stargaze's OST - Mr Thomas Regin. You may know him from his work on the [i]Blackwell [/i]series, [i]Unavowed [/i]or the upcoming [i]Nighthawks[/i]. Safe to say he has composed for one of the most cherished adventure games out there! 

If you haven't done so, wishlisting Stargaze will help us a lot and we will really appreciate this gesture. It will also, of course, keep you up to date on what's happening with the game :)

Stay safe folks, we'll soon be back with more news and announcements on Stargaze. 

All the best
Played With Fire

notes.title: Stargaze at PAX x EGX SEP 12-20 !
notes.notes:
Hey folks! 
Before we move to the details of the announcement, we would like to once again thank everyone that has played our previous demo during Steam’s Summer Festival. Your feedback has helped us a lot!

Now you will have another chance to see what is happening with Stargaze, thanks to the PAXxEGX event that will take place digitally between September 12-20!

We will have a fresh new demo out for you, available here on Steam during the event, for everyone to play – it includes some feedback we have received from you, as well as updated visuals and some other additional changes. 

We will be at your disposal during the event so feel free to reach out and chat with us! We’re also here at our Discussion Forums – say hi, share some thoughts on the game, ideas that you might have on it. We don’t bite!

Anyways, swing by the event, check out Stargaze’s demo and if you haven’t done so yet, wishilist the game. It helps us a lot! 

PAXxEGX event webpage - https://www.paxegx.com

Stay safe and see you around!
- Played With Fire Team

notes.title: Stargaze - 'First Peak' Demo
notes.notes:
Become a lone astronomer driven to research by curiosity and passion. Discover galactic secrets and trigger cosmic events from far far away. Influence a whole galaxy by masterful adjustments of your telescope.

Studio Played with Fire has just revealed their brand new Stargaze project. In its demo and trailers Stargaze showcases a melancholic mix of fairy-tale and interstellar research inspired by magical realism of The Little Prince.

Stargaze Demo awaits your discovery ONLY during the Steam Game Festival!
